Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a substrate-trapping approach with MLN4924 to stabilize E3 ligase-substrate interactions, followed by tandem affinity purification (AP-MS). While the study focuses on ubiquitylation, the MS analysis itself was performed on the purified complex (AP-MS) using spectral counting for quantification, rather than a diGly-remnant enrichment workflow.

cell_lines: stable HepG2 cell line that inducibly expresses a biologically active HBx
scope: Flag-SBP-HBx was precipitated with anti-Flag M2 resin (Sigma) affinity eluted with 200µg/ml 3x FLAG peptide (Sigma). Eluates were then incubated with streptavidin agarose (GE Life Sciences).
HBx-interacting proteins were then purified by sequential anti-FLAG and streptavidin binding and tryptic peptides were analyzed by LC-MS/MS.
We then performed APMS to identify bound proteins and potential substrates.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically analyzed material purified via tandem affinity purification (anti-Flag and streptavidin) from HepG2 cells to identify HBx-interacting substrates.
